name: uname
description: Prints kernel and system information: name, release, architecture, and more.

flags.description: Kernel release, e.g. 6.8.0-45-generic — the value you check after updates.
Everything: name, hostname, release, version, architecture.

examples.explanation: The running kernel version. After a kernel update, this only changes after a reboot.
Full identification: useful when pasting system info into bug reports.
Architecture — determines whether to download amd64 or arm64 packages.

about: uname reads from the running kernel via uname(2). The release (6.8.0-45-generic) encodes major.minor, distribution packaging, and kernel flavor (generic, lowlatency, rt). uname -m reports the kernel architecture, which differs from the userspace architecture on some 32-bit-on-64-bit setups.
useCases: Provide system details in support requests.
mistakes: Confusing kernel version with distribution version — use cat /etc/os-release for the latter.
